goal: Stop PSBT operations from retaining stale Taproot and MuSig2 signatures when inputs are added
Prevents RPC callers from receiving joined PSBTs carrying invalid signatures
agreement: Concept approval because it clears all signature fields and matches btclib-wallet (fametrano)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because joining already-signed Taproot PSBTs is an edge workflow with no risk of fund loss
Fixes an inconsistency with legacy inputs but affects a narrow set of multi-party signing flows
